scope: One of three public family assignments per classified record, split by how much of the world code carries: WorldCoder-type (state and rules only), Code-as-World-type (whitebox/proxy world plus generative rendering), or VibeWorlding-type (full 3D world in code, static scenes included). Every other record carries an unassigned_group: "gui" (Other · GUI world models), "benchmark" (Other · Benchmarks, with benchmark_target naming what it evaluates), or "survey" (related surveys, shown at the top of the README).

families.worldcoder: State-level programmatic dynamics and world-program induction.
families.code_as_world: Whitebox/proxy executable worlds rendered by generative models.
families.vibeworlding: Agentic construction of full 3D worlds in code, including static scenes.

records.comparison: It surveys agent harnesses built around video generation models, covering video production, interactive world modeling and recursive self-improvement, so the video model is the centre and code is one harness component. Here code is the world substrate: it carries state and rules, a whitebox world, or the full 3D world, and a video model is only one possible renderer.
records.comparison_zh: 该综述以视频生成模型为中心，梳理围绕它构建的 agent harness（视频制作、交互式世界建模、递归自我改进），代码只是 harness 的组件之一。本综述以代码为世界的载体：代码承担状态与规则、白模世界或完整 3D 世界，视频模型只是可选的渲染器之一。
